div.head: Abt 69
div.ab: Gif fot of weorðeþ, L scillingum forgelden.
Gif fot of weorðeþ, L scillingum forgelde.
Gif fot of weorðeþ, L scillingum forgelde(n).
Wenn ein Fuss ab[gehauen] wird, entgelte er mit 50 Schillingen.
If a foot is [cut] off, let him pay 50 shillings.
If a foot is struck off, 50 shillings shall be paid for it.
If a foot becomes [struck] off, let him pay with 50 shillings.

note.seg: Entweder scillingum muss in den Subjekts-Nom. -gas oder der Plural des Verbs zum Singular geändert werden. Ebenso 26. 70
Either scillingum must be changed to the nominative -gas as subject, or the plural verb to the singular. Likewise at 26. 70
